sections.content: Use change expressions such as empezar a, acostumbrarse a, adaptarse a and darse cuenta de to describe the experience of settling into a new place.

items.spanish: Poco a poco me adapté a la nueva ciudad.
items.english: Little by little I adapted to the new city.
I got used to the food.

items.spanish: Con el tiempo, empecé a sentirme en casa.
items.english: Over time, I began to feel at home.

sections.content: Describe adaptation as a process, not only as a final result.
